claim: A 7FFD write in an ISR maps the ROM over slot 1 on the Next, so a hook page or stack in slot 1 vanishes with interrupts on; return through game RAM that maps the hook page back.

evidence.text: The ISR pages by port 7FFD; on a Next (JNext at least) that resets slot 1 to the ROM and the ISR calls the ROM's IM 1, so a hook in slot 1 with interrupts on is unsafe unless the ISR puts slot 1 back.
evidence.quote: On a Next (JNext at least) that resets slot 1 to the ROM, and the ISR calls the ROM's IM 1.

evidence.text: KS1 Issue 2, core 3.03.00 (nxsuite M01): an unlocked 7FFD write set MMU 0 / 1 = $FF (ROM) and MMU 6 / 7 to the bank's pages; slots 2-5 kept.
